raw_description: Immaculate 4-plex in highly desirable Capitol Hill. Recent upgrades to plumbing and electrical. Cap rate approx 8%. Fully occupied with long-term tenants paying market rate.
Large lot but significant structural damage to foundation visible. Located in high-risk flood zone (Zone AE). FEMA insurance required. Previous mold remediation records available.
Incredible price for this brick duplex. Needs cosmetic work (paint/carpet). CAUTION: One tenant currently undergoing eviction process for non-payment (6 months behind). Roof age 15 years.
Classic Spanish style estate. Dated interior (1970s) but huge potential. Comps in area selling for $3.5M+. Large lot with pool allowance. Perfect luxury flip opportunity.
Solid C-class rental property. Section 8 approved tenants in place. steady high cash flow. ROI projected 12%+. Functional systems, older furnace.
Perfect starter home in booming suburb. Great school district (rated 9/10). New HVAC installed 2024. Turnkey condition, ready for immediate move-in or rental.
Mixed use building downtown. ATTENTION: Currently zoned industrial/warehouse, requires variance for residential conversion. City has denied previous applications. Historic facade must be preserved.
Multi-family near transit hub. Good fundamentals but located next to former dry cleaner site. Phase 1 environmental study recommended due to potential soil contamination. Price reflects risk.
